run_PlaNetVisualizer_cli: run the PlanetVisualizer CLI tool to generate a GIF comparing true vs predicted observations
create_PlaNetVisualizer_instance: create a PlanetVisualizer instance with a model directory, environment name, lookahead, and seed
run_PlaNetVisualizer_run_method: run the PlanetVisualizer run method to collect true observations and generate side-by-side comparison frames
review_PlaNetVisualizer_init: review the PlanetVisualizer constructor that sets up the DMC environment, PlaNetModel, ModelEnv, and CEM agent
summarize_PlaNetVisualizer_run: summarize the run method that executes agent actions in the real env then replays them in the model env
